about.title: About Me
about.text: Hi, I'm Moayyad, a 17 yo Palestinian with so many interests. I'm passionate about creative stuff like graphic design, so this is why I'm learning front end. I love exploring new ideas and spend my time learning languages, designing, learning historical facts, or whatever sounds interesting to me. I'm always curious, so every time I see a new skill that I like, I try to learn it — that's why I'm here.
